measurement_protocol.paired_order: conditional then marginal on even repetitions; reverse on odd repetitions
measurement_protocol.timed_sender: CPU input transfer + neural encoder + shared schedule + quantization + indexed rANS + 32-bit frame
measurement_protocol.timed_receiver: frame parse + regenerated schedule + indexed rANS decode + latent transfer + neural decoder + CPU output transfer

model_resources.mac_accounting: Conv2d/ConvTranspose2d/Linear multiply-accumulate counts, batch one; normalization, elementwise operations, and rANS reported through measured latency
